title: Selectors and labels
intro: Customers report failed checkouts. Narrow http_requests_total down to just the server errors (5xx) from the api service.

objectives.text: Select http_requests_total for service="api" with any 5xx status

hints: Label matchers go in curly braces: metric{label="value"}.
Use =~ for a regex match: status=~"5.." matches 500, 502, 503 and so on.
debrief: Label matchers are the core of PromQL: = exact, != not equal, =~ regex, !~ not regex. Regexes are fully anchored, so "5.." matches only three-character codes starting with 5. Next up: those counters still only go up. Time for rate().
